name: parents-kept-by-a-sub-section-answer
question: access-request.approver
source: 0070: a section keeps its parent, the editor copies a section as held, and an answer changes only answers (0010, Plans are values). The plan has a sub-section with an includeIf on its parent's question and an explicit enabled true, and a sub-section of that one. The answer replaces the sub-section's own. Kills a copy of the sections that drops the parent or the explicit switch.

source: 0070: the answers of a section are its own, at any depth, and the parent of every section stays. A question of a sub-section of a sub-section is active when every ancestor is on and its own gates hold. Kills a copy that keeps the parent of the first level only, or an answer stored under the parent.

name: parents-kept-by-a-clear

name: switch-off-a-parent-leaves-its-sub-sections-alone
source: 0070: switches cascade by the selector, and a section's switch is its own field. Turning a parent off stores enabled false on the parent only. A sub-section keeps its own switch, here an explicit true, and a sub-section of that one keeps none. Kills a switch that writes false on the sub-sections, or clears their fields.

name: switch-off-a-sub-section-alone
source: 0070: a sub-section can be turned off alone, and the parent and every other section are untouched. Its parent stays on it. Kills a switch that turns off the parent too, or drops the parent of the section it changes.

name: switch-on-a-parent-leaves-its-sub-sections-alone
source: 0050 and 0070: turning a section on removes its own field, and the explicit true of a sub-section is not removed with it. Kills a switch to on that clears the field of every sub-section.

name: question-of-a-sub-section-of-a-switched-off-section-is-refused
question: access-request.approver
source: 0070 and the finder contract: a sub-section is active only if its parent is active, so the questions of a sub-section of a switched-off section are not active, whatever its own switch says. The stored answers stay. Kills an editor that applies the answer, and a switch that lets the sub-section's own true count.

source: docs/reference/domain-model.md, Section: the id is a lowercase slug, never plan. The id plan names the plan scope, and the contract refuses it even when a malformed plan holds a section with that id

name: prune-removes-a-hidden-answer-of-every-kind
source: docs/decisions/0075-refreshing-a-personal-plan.md, Hidden answers stay until the owner prunes them: a hidden answer is a stored answer whose question the plan no longer declares. Text, a flag (false included), a list, and a Deferred answer are all answers, so the kind does not matter

name: prune-removes-answers-by-scope-and-exact-name-and-lists-them-by-whole-id
source: docs/decisions/0075-refreshing-a-personal-plan.md, Hidden answers stay until the owner prunes them: an answer is hidden when no variable of that name is declared in its own scope (answers.plan.<name> against the plan variables, answers.sections.<id>.<name> against that section), when the section does not exist, and a name declared only in another scope or in other case is not declared. Question ids are <scope>.<name>, and the list is in byte order of the whole id

name: prune-removes-the-hidden-answers-of-a-plan-with-people-and-keeps-the-rest
source: docs/decisions/0075-refreshing-a-personal-plan.md, Hidden answers stay until the owner prunes them: an answer to a question that is merely inactive (askIf unmet, a section off, a sub-section) or Deferred is not hidden and stays. Only plan.retired_contact has no variable and only retired.approver has no section. Every other field of the plan, the directory, ids, provenance, origin, and unknown fields stay

name: prune-keeps-the-answers-of-questions-that-are-not-active
source: docs/decisions/0075-refreshing-a-personal-plan.md, Hidden answers stay until the owner prunes them: an answer to a question that is merely inactive, because of askIf or an unselected section, is not hidden: it may become active again and is kept, a Deferred one too

name: prune-keeps-the-answers-of-a-switched-off-section-and-its-sub-sections
source: docs/decisions/0075-refreshing-a-personal-plan.md, Hidden answers stay until the owner prunes them: an answer to a question of a section that is off, and of its sub-section, is not hidden: it may become active again and is kept. An answers.plan map that is already empty stays as given

name: prune-a-plan-with-no-answers-comes-back-equal
source: docs/decisions/0075-refreshing-a-personal-plan.md, Hidden answers stay until the owner prunes them: a plan with no hidden answers comes back equal, and a map or list the plan leaves absent stays absent

name: prune-leaves-empty-answer-maps-as-given
source: docs/decisions/0075-refreshing-a-personal-plan.md, Hidden answers stay until the owner prunes them: a plan with no hidden answers comes back equal. A map with no answer holds no hidden answer, so prune does not remove it, whether or not its section exists

name: prune-goes-on-past-an-empty-answer-map
source: docs/decisions/0075-refreshing-a-personal-plan.md, Hidden answers stay until the owner prunes them: every hidden answer is removed. An empty answer map that sorts before a map with a hidden answer does not stop the prune, and stays as given

name: examples-kept-by-a-prune
source: docs/decisions/0075-refreshing-a-personal-plan.md, Hidden answers stay until the owner prunes them: prune changes nothing but the hidden answers. A variable's example is an illustration and not an answer (0045), so every example stays
